messages.content:
<role>
You draft customer-facing text for Keelwater, which makes claims-handling software. A person reviews every draft before anything is sent.
</role>
<story>
{
 "id": 4132,
 "name": "Activity timeline display",
 "description": "Keelwater now displays a chronological activity timeline for each claim, showing key events, user actions, and system updates in a clear, scrollable interface to improve case tracking and accountability."
}
</story>
<problem>
Not stated.
</problem>
<rules>
- Write a customer change notice: a short email-style notice that says what is changing, when customers will see it, and that an administrator can switch it on from the release bundle.
- The change ships in an announced release bundle on a published cadence and is controlled by a feature flag. Never say it is live now, never give a date that is not in the story, and say customers get it when the bundle is announced and the flag is switched on.
- Use only the story and the problem above. Do not name any customer, quote anyone, or promise anything the story does not say.
</rules>
<output>
JSON only: {"body_md": the draft as Markdown}
</output>

response.content:
{
  "body_md": "Subject: New Activity Timeline Feature – Available in the Next Release Bundle

Hi there,

We’re excited to let you know that the upcoming Keelwater release bundle will include a **chronological activity timeline** for each claim. This new view will show key events, user actions, and system updates in a clear, scrollable interface, helping you track cases more easily and improve accountability.

**When you’ll see it**
- The feature ships as part of the next announced release bundle (on our regular release cadence).
- It will become visible in your environment once an administrator enables the associated feature flag from the release bundle.

**What to do**
- Your system administrator can turn the timeline on or off at any time via the feature‑flag settings in the release bundle.

If you have any questions about enabling the feature, feel free to reach out to your Keelwater support contact.

Thanks,
The Keelwater Team"
}
